title: How to organise the nightstand right | Primary Bedroom
description:
This is the other sleeper's side, and it is the one zone in this room that is not yours to decide about.

This is the Nightstand Right in the Primary Bedroom. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
The top is clear enough to set a mug down without moving anything first, the lamp cord runs behind the leg rather than across the floor beside the bed, and any medication in the drawer is in date, capped, and closed away from a child or a dog who can climb onto this bed.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: You do not empty this drawer.
Straighten: Agree on the shared edge only: the floor beside this nightstand stays clear because you both walk past it, and
Shine: Dust the top, wipe the lamp base and the switch, and vacuum the slot between the nightstand and the bed frame
Safety: Medication is the one exception to leaving this side alone.
Standardize: Match the standard, not the contents.
Sustain: When the sheets come off, both nightstand tops get cleared and wiped as part of the same job, so one side cann

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The same item count on both tops, medication in date and closed away, and the drawer contents belonging to whoever sleeps on that side.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/primary-bedroom-the-nightstand-right.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
